hostname rt-r21
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description to sample upstream
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample lan
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.0
 ip policy route-map rm-r-pbr
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 ip ospf priority 1
 ip ospf hello-interval 10
 ip ospf dead-interval 40
 no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0
 description sample id
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.255
 no shutdown
!
ip route 192.0.2.64 255.255.255.192 198.51.100.254 1 tag 100
!
router ospf 1
 router-id 192.0.2.1
 redistribute static metric 20 metric-type 1 tag 100 route-map rm-r-static subnets
 no passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/1
!
router bgp 64496
 bgp router-id 192.0.2.1
 neighbor 203.0.113.2 remote-as 64497
 neighbor 203.0.113.2 route-map rm-r-in in
 neighbor 203.0.113.2 route-map rm-r-out out
 neighbor 203.0.113.2 send-community
 network 198.51.100.0 mask 255.255.255.0
 redistribute ospf 1 route-map rm-r-o2b
!
ip access-list extended al-r-pbr
 permit ip 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.127 any
!
ip prefix-list pl-r-any seq 10 permit 0.0.0.0/0 le 32
ip prefix-list pl-r-in seq 5 permit 0.0.0.0/0 le 24
ip prefix-list pl-r-out seq 5 permit 198.51.100.0/24
!
ip community-list standard CL-rm-r-in-10 permit 64497:100 local-as
!
route-map rm-r-in permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list pl-r-in
 match community CL-rm-r-in-10
 set local-preference 200
!
route-map rm-r-in permit 20
 match ip address prefix-list pl-r-any
!
route-map rm-r-o2b permit 10
 set metric 100
!
route-map rm-r-out permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list pl-r-out
 set metric 10
 set as-path prepend 64496 64496
 set community 64496:50 additive
!
route-map rm-r-pbr permit 10
 match ip address al-r-pbr
 set ip next-hop 203.0.113.2
!
route-map rm-r-static permit 10
 match tag 100
 set metric-type type-1
!
end
